title: Giriş formu hatalarını görünür kılma ve işlevsiz sağlayıcı butonlarını kaldırma
description: User reports sign-in is not working, visual issues, and buttons that do nothing; browser automation is avoided because the user reports it auto-blocks. Chief reproduced the route over HTTP: /tr/giris returns 200, while /api/hazirlik reports supabaseAnonKey=[REDACTED] The auth handler in GirisKayitSekmeleri has no try/catch around Supabase/network calls; rejected requests therefore produce no visible error. The form renders Google and e-Devlet buttons with no handlers, and password-reset fetch also lacks network-error handling. In the assigned auth component and all four locale messages only: validate sign-in email/password, catch auth/reset errors and render translated accessible feedback, prevent duplicate submissions with clear loading states, and remove/disable the inactive Google/e-Devlet controls rather than pretending they work. Preserve real password sign-in/registration/password-reset behavior. Do not edit .env or ask for/copy credentials; do not claim live login works until valid Supabase credentials are configured. No unrelated visual redesign.
acceptanceCriteria: Login page continues to serve over HTTP; invalid/empty login input is blocked before Supabase call; rejected/failed sign-in, registration, and reset operations show localized accessible feedback and restore controls; in-flight submissions are not duplicated; no clickable Google/e-Devlet control remains without a handler; all new visible strings are present in tr/en/ru/he; no secrets/config files are read or changed; only GirisKayitSekmeleri.tsx and the four locale JSON files change; npm run kalite, npm run build, git diff --check pass; live login is explicitly unverified because readiness reports supabaseAnonKey=[REDACTED]; OpenCode does not commit.
